ambiguities.text: The EIP provides no technical specifications regarding gas costs, stack operations, or execution conditions for the opcode.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume all technical behavior is inherited from the original SUICIDE opcode specification in the Yellow Paper. Gas costs and semantics remain unchanged.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'alias of SUICIDE opcode (rather than replacing it)' is ambiguous about whether both names coexist at the EVM level or only at compiler level.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the aliasing is purely at the high-level language/compiler level. At the EVM bytecode level, there is only one opcode 0xFF, and the naming is documentation-only.

implicit_assumptions.description: Existing contracts compiled with 'suicide' keyword continue to function identically after EIP-6 adoption.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Breaking backward compatibility would render existing deployed contracts non-functional, causing significant financial losses.

implicit_assumptions.description: Compiler updates to support 'selfdestruct' keyword are deployed and adopted by the developer community.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Without compiler support, developers cannot use the new keyword, defeating the purpose of the naming change.
